name: doc-team-charter
description: Drafts a Team Charter with mission, customers, scope and not-scope, roles with primary and backup owners, decision rights by decision type, working agreements and a review date. Use for "run doc-team-charter", "team charter", "nobody knows who decides", "new product team kickoff", "working agreements", "roles and responsibilities", "who owns what on this team", "reset how the team works", part of the Claude Docs for Product Managers Pack by 90n.
